scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:generate -w server && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/pg-terminate-idle-tx.mjs && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate:deploy -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.test:integration:full: npm run test:integration:setup && cross-env RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true DATABASE_URL=postgresql://goshopix:goshopix@127.0.0.1:5432/goshopix_test?schema=public npm run test:integration -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
